description: This file is a Python script that generates C++ code for Google Mock (gMock) mutants, including templates and functions for creating mock functors and dispatching methods/functions with pre-bound and call-time arguments. It contains code generation templates, utility functions, and a main function that outputs the generated C++ code.

classes.name: MutantRunner
classes.description: Interface for executing methods with parameters, used as a base for Mutant classes.

classes.name: Mutant
classes.description: Template class holding a pointer to an object and a method, supporting pre-bound arguments.

classes.name: MutantFunction
classes.description: Template class for function pointers with pre-bound arguments.

classes.name: MutantLateObjectBind
classes.description: Template class for late binding of objects via pointer to pointer, enabled with a macro.

classes.name: MutantFunctor
classes.description: Wrapper struct that acts as a functor, redirecting calls to MutantRunner implementations.

methods.name: SplitLine
methods.description: Splits a line at a comma, respecting a maximum width.

methods.name: Wrap
methods.description: Wraps a string at commas to ensure lines do not exceed a certain width.

methods.name: Clean
methods.description: Removes artifacts from generated C++ code strings.

methods.name: ExpandPattern
methods.description: Replaces '%' in a pattern with elements from a list.

methods.name: Gen
methods.description: Generates a comma-separated list of pattern replacements with sequential integers.

methods.name: GenAlpha
methods.description: Generates a comma-separated list of pattern replacements with sequential lowercase letters.

methods.name: Merge
methods.description: Joins a list of strings with commas, filtering out empty strings.

methods.name: GenTuple
methods.description: Creates a tuple type string with a specified size.

methods.name: FixCode
methods.description: Wraps long lines in code snippets for better readability.

methods.name: GenerateDispatch
methods.description: Outputs code for dispatching methods/functions with various pre-bound and call-time argument counts.

methods.name: GenerateCreateFunctor
methods.description: Outputs code for creating functor objects with different argument bindings and calling conventions.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that outputs the entire generated C++ code, including headers, templates, and functors.
